CANONICAL_NAME.value: Core War (Redcode / MARS) -- warring programs in a virtual machine

VERSION.value: github.com/rodrigosetti/corewar master as of 2026-09-12 (a Redcode MARS implementation; commit in hashes)

value.lineage: Core War (1984, A.K. Dewdney): two or more programs written in Redcode run in a shared circular memory on the Memory Array Redcode Simulator (MARS); they copy, bomb and evade each other until one survives -- a self-replication / competition substrate that predates and prefigures artificial life

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: a virtual battleground for self-replicating, competing programs

value.built_to: run competing self-modifying programs in a shared virtual memory and see which survives -- a substrate where programs copy themselves, attack rivals' code, and defend, entirely inside a tiny instruction set
value.pressure: a fixed shared memory and a single CPU shared round-robin; a warrior must replicate or damage others faster than it is damaged
value.success_means: in its native domain, surviving longer than the opponent; as a fossil, a running self-replication/competition VM Nyx can perturb
